stops.narrative: Read a recruiting appeal as persuasion within a global imperial war.
Keep war chronology, genocide and individual experience visible.
Investigate scientific success and a particular archive of political responses.

conclusion: Events did not happen by themselves. Institutions and choices connected science, state power, propaganda and violence. People’s lives should not disappear behind either triumphal images or totals.

evidence.prompt: Why does this atlas keep more than one starting date for the Second World War context?

options.text: War in Asia and war in Europe had different chronologies, while the Holocaust has its own 1933–1945 frame.
options.feedback: USHMM distinguishes these connected histories. One regional starting date cannot stand for all of them.

options.text: All regions entered the same conflict simultaneously in 1939.
